name: EZ Bar Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with your feet planted and hold the EZ bar above your chest with a close overhand grip.
Retract your shoulder blades into the bench and brace your core before lowering the bar.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to lower the bar smoothly to your lower chest.
Press the EZ bar straight back up until your elbows are fully extended.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked near your torso rather than flaring them wide to emphasize the triceps.
Avoid gripping so narrowly that your wrists bend inward or feel strained.
